snippet.title: Backrooms Level X – Official Launch Trailer | Survival Horror Game (2025) | Steam Release
snippet.description:
Backrooms Level X is now available on Steam 🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303230/Backrooms_Level_X/

Step into the unknown with Backrooms Level X, the ultimate survival horror experience inspired by the viral Backrooms mythos. Available now on Steam with a 20% launch discount for a very limited time!

In Backrooms Level X, you’ll explore endless, eerie corridors, solve mind-bending puzzles, and face horrifying entities as you try to escape a reality-bending nightmare. Will you survive the horrors lurking in the shadows?

Features:
🔸Atmospheric first-person survival horror
🔸13+ unique, terrifying levels
🔸Intense boss encounters
🔸Deep environmental storytelling
🔸Inspired by the Backrooms internet legend

🔔 Subscribe for more horror game updates!
🎮 Console releases coming soon to PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.
